name: Line-end voltage-measurement interface
summary: Places the selected voltage measurement on the identified line side of its bay.
description: Places the selected voltage measurement on the identified line side of its bay. A bay circuit arrangement groups the switching, measuring and protection interfaces associated with a specific network circuit. A line bay, transformer bay and reactor bay share some devices but connect different kinds of primary equipment.

In a switchyard single-line drawing, the bay arrangement helps the reader follow the circuit from its bus connection to the external line, transformer or compensation equipment and identify the measurement boundaries along the path. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Line conductor voltage” at the input and “Line-voltage measuring path” at the output. Line-side and bus-side voltage references differ.
